name: Western University
description: Western University is a public research university in London, Ontario, founded in 1878. It is home to the Ivey Business School and the Schulich School of Medicine & Dentistry.
whyIncluded: Western University is among the 10 universities in Canada most chosen by international students (2,437 full-time international undergraduates and 1,270 full-time international master's students in 2024-25), per the FinexisEdu shortlist research of October 2026.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Engineering Science (BESc)
programmes.summary: First-year tuition and compulsory fees for new international students. Western raises international fees most years, so later years may cost more. Health insurance (UHIP) is extra.
programmes.notes: Western 2026-27 Fall/Winter undergraduate full-time international fee schedule, 'Engineering' Year 1 row: total single payment C$67,384.46 = tuition C$64,310.00 + student organization, orientation (Year 1 only), USC health and dental plan, transit pass, faculty donation and faculty society fees, + UHIP C$948.00. Compulsory = total - tuition - UHIP = C$2,126.46. The C$948 UHIP column matches the 12-month UHIP rate (C$316/term on the Fall 2026 grad schedule; the schedule's footnote still quotes C$792, the 2025-26 rate). One-time C$50 Western One Card fee for new students excluded. History: same Year 1 row and method on the 2025-26 schedule (UHIP C$792) and 2024-25 schedule (UHIP C$756). First year is common to all engineering programmes (e.g. Software, Mechanical, Electrical).

programmes.name: Bachelor of Science (BSc) in Computer Science
programmes.summary: Years 1 to 3 cost C$55,167 a year in tuition; year 4 drops to the general Science rate of C$46,597 (2026-27 rates). Fees rise most years. Compulsory fees of about C$2,050 included; health insurance (UHIP) is extra.
programmes.notes: Western 2026-27 Fall/Winter undergraduate full-time international fee schedule, 'Computer Science' Year 1 row: total single payment C$58,166.46 = tuition C$55,167.00 + student organization, orientation (Year 1 only), USC health and dental plan, transit pass, faculty donation and faculty society fees, + UHIP C$948.00. The C$948 UHIP column matches the 12-month UHIP rate (C$316/term on the Fall 2026 grad schedule; the schedule's footnote still quotes C$792, the 2025-26 rate). One-time C$50 Western One Card fee for new students excluded. History: same Year 1 row and method on the 2025-26 schedule (UHIP C$792) and 2024-25 schedule (UHIP C$756). Computer Science Years 1-3 are charged a higher rate; Year 4 drops to the general Science rate (C$46,597 in 2026-27). laterYears added 2026-10-08 from the figures above; annualTuition is now the year-1 figure.

programmes.name: Master of Engineering (MEng) in Electrical and Computer Engineering
programmes.summary: Yearly tuition for international students over three terms (fall, winter, summer), plus compulsory student fees. Fees rise most years. Health insurance (UHIP) is extra.
programmes.notes: Western Fall 2026 graduate full-time international schedule, row 'Faculty of Engineering Electrical & Computer Engineering MEng Program Specific Per Term', per term: tuition C$15,717.33, student organization C$130.55, UWO ancillary C$199.48, transit pass C$105.68, UHIP C$316.00, health and dental plan C$702.71. Annual = 3 terms: tuition C$15,717.33 x 3; compulsory = (organization + ancillary + transit) x 3 + health and dental plan once (the schedule says the plan covers September to August) = C$2,009.84; UHIP excluded. History: same row and method from the Fall 2025 schedule (tuition C$15,259.67/term; fees 126.89, 195.56, 103.81 per term + plan 641.31 = C$1,920.09) and Fall 2024 schedule (tuition C$14,815.33/term; fees 94.68, 191.73, 96.77 + plan 608.45 = C$1,757.99). Other MEng programmes (chemical, civil, mechanical) have the same fee.

programmes.name: Master of Business Administration (MBA), Ivey Business School
programmes.summary: Tuition for the one-year Ivey MBA starting January 2027, plus student, ancillary and case-book fees. Health insurance (UHIP) is extra.
programmes.notes: Ivey MBA tuition and living expenses page: international tuition C$136,310 for the programme year beginning January 2027 (paid in January, May and September 2027 instalments). Compulsory = Western student organization and ancillary fees incl. MBA Association fee C$2,300 + Ivey course material fees (case books) C$2,700; UHIP C$820 excluded. C$5,000 deposit is credited to tuition so not counted. No earlier-year figure on the page.
